description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

2-layer LayerNorm-free transformer: prev-char attention heads + trigram MLP detectors for ~70 TREC keywords, layer-2 priority attention picks the highest-priority keyword's class (default ENTY). Hand-written, no training.
Same keyword decision list as v1 but default class changed from ENTY to DESC when no keyword fires.
v1 decision list (default ENTY) plus low-priority ENTY trigrams appended at the end: dog, cat, bird, language, music, shape, letter, element, substance.
v3 plus a lowest-priority DESC trigram 'is ' so 'what is ...' questions with no other keyword are DESC.
v4 but 'any' (matches 'company') replaced by 'man' (matches 'many'); 'woman'/'human' trigrams added at top priority as HUM.
v4 plus 'woman'/'human' HUM trigrams at top priority, and HUM occupation/role nouns (actress, actor, athlete, lawyer, president, team, king, crooner, writer) in the HUM group.
v6 but dropping the noisy HUM trigrams (ath, pre, eam, roo, rit); keeps woman/human and actress/actor/lawyer HUM trigrams.
Adds a third previous-char head so keywords match whole word starts (' xyz') or 4-letter words instead of substrings; same priority list otherwise.
v8 plus NUM measure words (big, tall, high, deep, wide) and LOC 'nation'.
